releases.name: DSSMM SuperFW — Test 4 (Hardware Validation Pending)
releases.body:
## New features

- ~~Title artwork now supports original EZ-FLASH GBA thumbnails matched by the four-letter game code in the ROM header, after filename-matched artwork.~~ not working yet
- Settings and option menus use left-aligned text, and the browser bar no longer has decorative DSSMM text over the existing icons.

## New fixes

- Title and Box artwork check the `CUSTOM` filename before the mirrored ROM filename. Title then checks the native EZ-FLASH game-code artwork path.
- Removed the clipped outline around the artwork preview.

## Summary of past features

- All three builds use DSSMM Light and Title artwork by default, with shared theme, accent, and List/Title/Box controls. Chis-only hardware features remain specific to Chis.
- Adds DSSCC-compatible filename-matched title and box artwork, manual themes and color accents, and `/SYSTEM` save, state and diagnostic folders. Existing SuperFW game loading, saves, cheats and in-game menus remain; NOR support is available on Chis.
- Based on [David Guillen Fandos’s SuperFW](https://github.com/davidgfnet/superfw). Bundled emulators remain upstream versions; this port does not include MiGoomba.

## Summary of past fixes

- Older unversioned and version 1 UI settings migrate to DSSMM Light and Title defaults; version 2 settings keep their saved choices.
- Artwork reads are bounded and reject malformed images; DSSCC `DST1` transparency is supported. Existing root-level save and state data remains usable when no matching `/SYSTEM` copy exists.

**Hardware and validation:** Test 4 artwork and menu changes have not been checked on hardware. The earlier Test 1 Chis image booted on one SuperChis Prime v1.0 and showed SuperFW 0.22 with manual themes; that smoke test does not validate artwork. SuperCard SD and Lite also remain physically untested. Hosted checks passed on all five repository branches, and all three board images were built and verified locally.

Choose the download for your card: SuperChis/SuperChis Prime, SuperCard SD, or SuperCard Lite. Back up your SD card, saves and current firmware. Review [upstream installation and recovery guidance](https://superfw.davidgf.net/docs/install/flash/) before any internal-flash write, confirm your recovery method, and never interrupt save or flash writes. Existing legacy save files are left in place; see the [SYSTEM layout guide](https://github.com/voluptuary/dssmm/blob/superfw-test4/superfw/docs/SYSTEM-LAYOUT.md) and [artwork setup guide](https://github.com/voluptuary/dssmm/blob/superfw-test4/superfw/docs/ARTWORK-SETUP.md).

Credits: David Guillen Fandos/davidgfnet for SuperFW; ChisBread and collaborators for SuperChis hardware; Merkin for this port; DSSCC and its FrankieT19 DS Style scraper lineage for artwork tooling. Firmware and component license notices remain in the source.

releases.name: DS Style Merkin Mix 8.4.1 — BLUE Test 4 (Hardware Untested)
releases.body:
**NEWER EZ-FLASH OMEGA DEFINITIVE EDITION B / BLUE ONLY — HARDWARE UNTESTED. UPDATE AT YOUR OWN RISK.**

Do not install on the older DE Rev. A/B, Original OMEGA, or another model.

Software regression checks passed; installation, boot, saves, plugins, NOR timing and runtime stack peaks remain physically unverified. Stock-size bounds do not prove updater acceptance. Native 64 MiB clean loading remains; new large-ROM add-ons and physical warm return are unqualified. Flash polling and SD/NOR power-loss limits remain.

Back up the SD card and `.esv` saves. Old emulator save states are not guaranteed compatible; prefer in-game battery saves when transitioning.

FrankieT19's reviewed Test 5 also states that physical EZODE-B validation is outstanding. Our comparison and independent adaptations do not change that qualification. Load style now requires the new sealed DSSMM BLUE format.

### New features

- Adopted a **firmware-free, stock-size BLUE update** informed by **FrankieT19's BLUE port**: stock-size instead of the previous oversized image, with current artwork and MiGoomba retained. Use the official BLUE kernel for FPGA updates.
- Added complete-image integrity checks for Load style. The new DSSMM BLUE seal checks the model/header, exact size and CRC before staging an update.

### New fixes

- Block new game/save loads and manual FRAM operations while an earlier battery-save backup is still pending.
- Stop startup/NOR browsing from writing metadata; recognise factory-erased catalog/map data in RAM, require allocation-map agreement, preserve unknown reservations and sort entries by physical ROM page.
- Reserve the full NOR add-on extent and reject invalid patch offsets or programming-block crossings; store launcher preferences separately from stock Mode B.
- Correct SD save-state staging to BLUE's DDR memory, check exact size/signature and file errors, and create missing states without overwriting files after an I/O error.
- Block new and existing **NOR add-ons with save states** until their persistent SD-sector maps and runtime are validated. Existing entries/files are preserved; turn save states off when writing NOR add-ons.

### Summary of past features

- **MiGoomba v0.1** by **michyprima** for GB/GBC, retaining per-game `.esv` paths and 64 KiB save handling; based on Jagoomba Color, Goomba Color and Goomba.
- **FrankieT19's DS Style foundation and separate v8.0 interface work:** Start screen, themes, sounds, selection/launch effects, Auto theme, View grouping, Open SYSTEM, boot preferences and favorites behavior.
- List, List + Art and horizontal/vertical carousels, title/box art and side previews; favorites, recents, last-played startup, accent colors and readable settings.
- Name/header-code/mirrored artwork, long filenames, marked transparency and custom fallbacks; cached/scaled previews and optimized artwork lookup/rendering.
- Optional remembered cheats, off by default, by **exploitz86**, with collapsible groups from **SkillerCMP**, adapted by **exploitz86**; multilingual support including Thai/Chinese and a text/Markdown viewer.
- BLUE-native 64 MiB/5G handling, hardware drivers, in-game options and NOR allocation; themed NOR progress and SD-side NOR artwork paths.

### Summary of past fixes

- Guarded embedded-emulator payload sizes/alignment and tested exact game offsets, DMA copies and cache bounds.
- Bounded NES detection/patch writes, full-width cheat/save sizes and malformed marked artwork; corrected Chinese paths and stopped save loading on close errors.
- Checked game/plugin limits, SD reads/copies/closes, compressed payloads and stack-safe boot; restored small headerless plugins and directory records after failed loads.
- Safer staged saves/settings and filename checks; bounded PSRAM/NOR patch copies, consistent block padding, NOR erase/program/catalog readback and reserve-before-publish ordering.
- Preserved cheat-group selection/visible-row fixes and removed the black plugin-launch strip; checked kernel staging before replacing an update file.

Thanks to **FrankieT19**, **EZ-FLASH**, **Sterophonick**, **exploitz86**, **SkillerCMP**, **aidiadayo**, **Kekun** and **ChaN**; and to **michyprima**, **Jaga / EvilJagaGenius**, **Dwedit** and **FluBBa** for the emulator lineage. Merkin Mix artwork and port work is maintained by **Merkin / voluptuary**. [Credits and provenance](https://github.com/voluptuary/dssmm/blob/v8.4.1-blue-test4/ezfblue/CREDITS.md).

This project was developed with AI assistance.

releases.name: DS Style Merkin Mix 8.4.0 — Original OMEGA Test 4 (Hardware Untested)
releases.body:
**ORIGINAL EZ-FLASH OMEGA ONLY — HARDWARE UNTESTED. UPDATE AT YOUR OWN RISK.**

Do not install on DE Rev. A/B, the newer DE B / BLUE, or another model.

Software regression checks passed; installation, boot, saves, plugins, NOR timing and runtime stack peaks remain physically unverified. Native/plugin combinations remain limited to 32 MiB. NOR deletion keeps the newest-title restriction; flash polling and metadata power-loss limits remain. Extra custom theme/color slots are excluded.

Back up the SD card and `.esv` saves. Old emulator save states are not guaranteed compatible; prefer in-game battery saves when transitioning.

### New features

- Replaced the built-in GB/GBC emulator with **MiGoomba v0.1** by **michyprima**, based on Jagoomba Color, Goomba Color and Goomba. The Original OMEGA ezo variant intentionally does not save emulator settings when its menu closes.

### New fixes

- Added embedded-emulator size/alignment guards and loader regression checks for exact game offsets, DMA copies and cache bounds.

### Summary of past features

- **FrankieT19's Original OMEGA DS Style v8.0 foundation:** DS menus, Start screen, themes, sounds, selection effects and launch presentation.
- List, List + Art and horizontal/vertical carousels, title/box art and side previews; favorites, recents, last-played startup, Light/Dark/Auto themes and accent colors.
- Name/header-code/mirrored artwork, long filenames, marked transparency, per-extension defaults and CUSTOM Only rounded corners; cached/scaled previews, optimized lookup/rendering and refreshed splash/help art.
- Indexed long-filename identities, Clean list and On, Not SYSTEM wrapping; readable settings, Chinese/Thai support and the text/Markdown viewer.
- Optional remembered cheats, off by default, by **exploitz86**, with collapsible groups from **SkillerCMP**, adapted by **exploitz86**.
- Themed NOR progress and SD-side NOR artwork paths; staged save/settings replacement and 832 bytes less working-RAM use.

### Summary of past fixes

- Bounded NES detection/patch writes, malformed artwork checks and save-file sizes; corrected Chinese paths and stopped save loading on close errors.
- Checked raw/compressed plugin payloads, decompression selection, boot copies and arguments; rebuilt directory records after failed PSRAM loads and removed incomplete copies.
- Corrected thumbnail-cache reuse, carousel VRAM/code bounds, transparency/rounding, settings aliases, Thai table alignment and menu button hints.
- Safer save/settings replacement, exact SD reads, PSRAM-bank and patch boundaries, NOR input/catalog/allocation checks and FF padding; preserved cheat-group selection/visible-row fixes.

Thanks to **FrankieT19**, **EZ-FLASH**, **Sterophonick**, **exploitz86**, **SkillerCMP**, **aidiadayo**, **Kekun** and **ChaN**; and to **michyprima**, **Jaga / EvilJagaGenius**, **Dwedit** and **FluBBa** for the emulator lineage. Merkin Mix artwork and port work is maintained by **Merkin / voluptuary**. [Credits and provenance](https://github.com/voluptuary/dssmm/blob/v8.4.0-omega-test4/ezfomega/CREDITS.md).

This project was developed with AI assistance.
